scripts.dev: bun run dev:workspace && bun run --parallel dev:core dev:ray dev:web
scripts.dev:core: go tool wgo run -file .go -xdir node_modules -xdir .dev ./cmd/superlexical serve .dev/workspace
scripts.generate:api: go run ./cmd/superlexical openapi > openapi.json && bun --filter @superlexical/prism-web generate:api
scripts.check: bun run format && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
